Army Field Note

Part one recovered. Hole up here for the night of the blood moon. The next part is at the army post in the mountains north of Cinder Bay: go north through the pass beside this post into the burnt forest, then follow the road west.

Part two recovered. Hole up here for the night of the blood moon. The next part is at the army post in the mountains north of Dune Point: go north through the pass beside this post into the desert, then follow the road east.

Part three recovered. Hole up here for the night of the blood moon. The next part is at the army position in the mountains north of Frostport: go north through the pass beside this post into the snow, then follow the road west.

Part four recovered. Hole up here for the night of the blood moon. The next part is at the fortified military site in the mountains north of Ashmouth: go north through the pass beside this post into the wasteland, then follow the road east. It will be heavily guarded.

That is every part. Build the Oxygen Destroyer at a workbench (with 10 electrical parts and 20 forged steel), place it on the shore in front of Ashmouth where he comes out of the sea, and arm it before the last blood moon ends. If he comes within 100 m of it, he dies.
